notes: ORIENTATION: Nintendo JP publishes the console standing up: [本体] 幅 (width) 44, 高さ (height) 157, 奥行き (depth) 215.4 mm, '（突起部分を除く）' → excludes_projections true. Per the §3 contract this is the 'vertical' state; the horizontal body is not published, so 'body' stays null (a generator may rotate the vertical state, but that is its rule, not a fact here).

STAND: the same page gives the stand alone, [本体スタンド] 幅 55.4mm 高さ 42mm 奥行き 225.6mm （突起部分を除く）; the combined console-on-stand envelope is not published, so no with_stand state. The stand ships in the set ('Wii本体専用スタンド × 1') but features.stand_included is left unset because the set contents changed over time (Wii Sports Resort bundle notes on the same page).

ports: Nintendo JP 入出力端子 list: USB2.0 ×2 → usb_a 2 (the page says USB 2.0, not the connector type; Type A is our reading of the kind, flagged); SDカードスロット ×1 → sd_card 1; GameCube controller ports ×4 → controller_proprietary 4; GameCube memory card slots ×2 → memory_card 2; AVマルチ出力端子 ×1 → multi_av_out 1; センサーバー接続端子 (sensor bar connector) ×1 has no §3 kind, not filed. power_in from the US setup manual's 'DC Input Connector'.

media/controls: Nintendo of America's Wii Operations Manual (setup), archived copy of nintendo.com/consumer/downloads/WiiOpMn_setup.pdf (print code RVL-S-GL-USZ), 'Components': Game Disc slot → disc_slot 1; POWER Button → power_button; RESET → reset_button; EJECT Button → eject_button; SYNCHRO Button has no §3 kind (noted). Born-digital PDF text via pypdf.

mass: not on Nintendo JP's page; the JP setup manual PDF (https://www.nintendo.co.jp/wii/support/pdf/wiimanual_setup.pdf) does not text-extract (custom font encoding), so mass_g stays null; a human read of that PDF may find 質量.
released: JP launch of the white model. external_ids: Wikidata Q8079 ('Wii'); igdb_platform 'wii' is P5795 on that item.
